commit_message:
ps.isolated: pinned git sources (GitSource, ensure_git_source, Runtime(source=)) (#19)

* ps.isolated: GitSource, ensure_git_source, check_git_source, dir_lock; Runtime(source=) pins a checkout (#18)

Moved from voxy.envs (voxy#123): a repository at one full commit SHA, fetched once
(that commit only) under a lock into a .partial folder renamed into place, verified on
every reuse (HEAD is the commit, no edits to tracked files), git run without GIT_*.
Runtime gains source=: its hint checks the commit out, interpreter() refuses a root at
another commit (SourceMismatch, a RuntimeNotInstalled, with the commands to move it).

* GitSource review fixes: Windows read-only cleanup, strip only git's location vars and never prompt, blobless fallback when a server refuses a SHA, cached and non-locking check, env_var roots warn, private lock, SHA-256

* GitSource re-review fixes: no check cache (missed git reset and later edits), fall back only when a server refuses a SHA and say when the commit is on no ref, ssh BatchMode, no gc in .partial, rmtree handler only for read-only files
